home.title: Pulse
home.description: A lifelong electronic health record. Your history in one place, shared only with the clinicians you choose — and every access recorded.

history.title: A history that travels
history.body: Diagnoses, prescriptions, lab reports and procedures — one timeline, in the order you lived it, for life.

consent.title: Consent you control
consent.body: Clinicians read your history only with your explicit consent — scoped, time-boxed, and revoked in one click.

audit.title: Every access recorded
audit.body: See exactly who viewed your records and when. The log is append-only — even we cannot rewrite it.

app.name: Pulse
app.confidentialityNote: Record access is consent-gated and audit-logged.
